Use when the capability under optimization is rfe-creator's rfe.speedrun/rfe.create/rfe.auto-fix/rfe.review/rfe-feasibility-review/rfe.split/rfe.submit skills, scored by agent-eval-harness's RFE-creation eval.

# rfe-skill-pipeline

The capability is a directory holding SEVERAL independent Claude Code Agent Skill
packages that together form one pipeline: a problem statement goes in, and an
RFE (Jira Feature Request) comes out, created / reviewed / auto-fixed / split /
submitted.

- `rfe.create` — draft a new RFE from a problem statement (WHAT/WHY, no HOW).
- `rfe.review` — score against the 5-criterion rubric, auto-revise, fetch context.
- `rfe-feasibility-review` — technical feasibility fork used by `rfe.review`.
- `rfe.auto-fix` — batch review + auto-revise + split, non-interactive.
- `rfe.split` — decompose an oversized RFE into right-sized children.
- `rfe.submit` — write to Jira (skipped under `--dry-run`).
- `rfe.speedrun` — the end-to-end orchestrator over all of the above.

Each is a normal Agent Skill package (`SKILL.md` + optional `prompts/*.md` /
`*-template.md`), so every authoring rule from the `skill-package` capability
applies per sub-skill — this capability's `validate()` delegates there unchanged.

## What this capability adds on top of skill-package

rfe-creator enforces its own per-skill body budget via `.skillsaw.yaml`
(`context-budget`: warn at 4000 bytes, error at 8000 bytes, measured on the raw
`SKILL.md` file). An edit that grows a skill past that line is a real problem
even when it is otherwise a perfectly valid Agent Skill — `validate()` checks
every sub-skill's `SKILL.md` byte size and reports it alongside skill-package's
own findings.

## Editing this capability

- Edit `<skill>/SKILL.md` (and its `prompts/*.md` / template files) like any
  skill-package component — `materialize()` writes `{"<skill>/SKILL.md": text}`.
- Stay within budget: trim prose before adding more of it. `rfe.review` and
  `rfe.speedrun` are already over the 8000B error budget in the seed — any edit
  to them should shrink, not grow, unless the trade is deliberate.
- Never make a produced RFE prescribe HOW (implementation) — that is a scoring
  criterion (`rfe_quality`), not just a style preference.
- Preserve the frontmatter contract the eval's judges parse verbatim: review
  files need `rfe_id, score, pass, recommendation, feasibility, scores.*`.
